links.comparator_used: Trust score without the confidence calibration component (uncalibrated classifier confidence) in the ablation
links.outcome: Expected calibration error (ECE) and clinician override rate
links.effect: ECE 0.007 with calibration vs. 0.024 without; override rate essentially unchanged (3.57% vs. 3.49%)
links.quote: Systematic ablation identified embedding-space similarity as the architecturally critical trust component: its removal increased override rates from 3.57% to 77–81% across all model sizes, while confidence calibration improved ECE (0.007 vs. 0.024) without meaningfully altering override behavior (3.57% vs. 3.49%).

design_hint: calibrated composite trust scoring and override thresholding
